codex_entry_gate: Detect installed Godot major/minor version before writing version-specific APIs.
Locate existing local ANDROMEDA_EDITOR_BRIDGE/transport before creating a new one.
Run existing 06_GODOT_LIVING_V1_5 runtime gate without modifying it.
Run Stage16A Python accumulated suite before first Godot mutation.
Create Stage16B in a new Godot runtime folder; do not overwrite sealed historical gates.

Main.tscn.responsibility: vertical slice composition only; no gameplay authority

notes: Mouse click commands remain authoritative through bridge.
No body-balance mechanic.
Movement must not snag on micro-relief.
Dialogue does not freeze NPC or player.
Name visible on hover only.
Combat result comes from Stage03/07 authority.
Enemy bar stays screen-aligned and straight.
Physics only until settling, then freeze/sleep.
Pickup authoritative only at <=0.5m.
Inventory full leaves drop active.
Icon is category-based, not unique item art.
Tree/rock/ore/flora/agriculture/hunt/fish outputs use Ground Loot channel.
Visual, collision and traversal surfaces remain conceptually separated.
No free orbit in first slice.
Occluder fade before abrupt camera shortening.
Camera feedback cannot change resolved click target.
World-first contextual HUD; no permanent large panels.
White rounded bubble.
Normal text medium gray.
Important text soft light orange.

autoloads.role: Transport/session/snapshot/command envelopes only; never decides gameplay results.

autoloads.role: Maps Godot events to Stage16A interaction intents.

input_map.behavior: GROUND=>MOVE; target=>SELECT without interrupting existing path; GroundLoot=>APPROACH/PICKUP exception.
Click only. Ground=>MOVE; hostile=>CHASE_ATTACK; NPC/object/resource/vehicle=>contextual approach/action; loot=>approach/pickup.
Attack selected enemy through combat authority; cooldown cannot be bypassed.
Approach and interact with selected non-enemy target.
Open/close inventory; inventory not permanently visible.
Camera zoom toward candidate min; no forced combat zoom.
Local menu policy; must not silently mutate Living state.

collision_layers_candidate.use: active NPC/enemy/animal body; hard-body behavior requires Godot feel validation

collision_layers_candidate.name: GROUND_LOOT
collision_layers_candidate.use: physical ground drops and pickup query

collision_layers_candidate.name: HIT_HURT_SENSOR
collision_layers_candidate.use: combat query sensors; result still backend authoritative

navigation.player: NavigationAgent3D path follower; click target projected from Camera3D screen ray.
navigation.actors: NavigationAgent3D for active actors; LOD/systemic actors remain outside detailed Godot scene.
navigation.pickup: Clicked loot creates path to reachable position; pickup attempted only once physical distance <=0.5m.
navigation.resources: Approach interaction range determined by target contract; produced result becomes Ground Loot.
navigation.rule: Stage16B must tune NavigationMesh/CharacterBody against these candidates; failure changes candidate values, not authorial canon.

phases.SYSTEMIC: Living only, no detailed Godot scene

terrain_and_streaming.surface_rule: Traversal cost uses Stage16A surface+slope+load; Stage05 inventory remains weight authority.

camera_candidates.validation: visual/physical tuning required in Godot; values are not final art/balance

dialogue_ui.important_dialogue: world bubble + subtle bottom accessibility line

hud.enemy_bar: only when relevant/engaged; straight stable above head; alpha gets HP+shield
hud.auto_pickup_control: small ON/OFF UI control; setting persisted per profile
hud.feedback_priority: player danger > combat result > blocked action > quest > interaction > pickup > movement > ambient

ground_loot.auto_pickup: per-profile ON/OFF; passive; never interrupts current action
ground_loot.settling: physical drop settles safely, then freezes/sleeps; prevent endless rolling/terrain penetration
ground_loot.stacking: stackable quantities may be represented by one physical drop
ground_loot.icon_policy: category/type icon, not unique item icon

bridge_contract.security: Godot client must never be able to supply authoritative damage, inventory grant, currency result, quest completion or canonical mutation.

implementation_order: B04 terrain cell + slope/stamina/load + streaming ACTIVE/PRELOAD/SYSTEMIC
B05 NPC + realtime dialogue + hover/choices + minimal HUD
B06 enemy + combat presentation + health/shield bars + game feel
B07 universal Ground Loot + pickup 0.5m + Auto Pickup persistence
B11 integrated vertical-slice playthrough + performance/regression + restore checkpoint

acceptance_gates.requirement: Godot starts with zero parser/runtime errors and existing V1.5 runtime gate remains PASS.
Left click ground moves; left click target selects without unintended movement interruption; left click loot approaches/picks.
Right click is click-only contextual action; hostile chase/attack respects cooldown.
Pickup impossible above 0.5m, through blocker, or before drop settles.
Tree/rock/ore/flora/agriculture/hunt/fish/enemy physical output appears as Ground Loot before inventory.
Auto Pickup ON/OFF works, persists, and never interrupts attack/movement.
Terrain has subtle relief; movement stable; no micro-collision snagging/camera jitter; no body-balance mechanic.
Slope+surface+load visibly affect stamina while Stage05 remains weight authority.
Large logical areas stream by cells; only active+preload detailed; distant area remains Living SYSTEMIC.
Realtime NPC dialogue uses rounded white bubble, gray normal text, light-orange important text, no Next button, no world pause.
NPC names appear on hover only; multiple NPC conversations alternate without bubble spam; choices appear near NPC.
Important dialogue simultaneously appears in world bubble and subtle bottom accessibility line.
HUD remains minimal and contextual; enemy bars stable/straight; alpha HP+shield; inventory toggled with I.
Camera stays stable over micro-relief, zoom clamps, occluders fade, no forced combat zoom/free orbit.
Game-feel feedback never changes gameplay result; local hit freeze only; reduced-motion disables camera impulse/local freeze.
Vendor requires explicit quote/execute; approaching/clicking shop never auto-purchases.
Save/reload preserves player, world, Ground Loot, Auto Pickup, quest/economy and death recovery state.
Death exits dungeon where applicable, respawns at safe waypoint, preserves XP/items under Stage15 policy.
Full vertical slice spawn→explore→dialogue→quest→combat→loot→gather→vendor→save→death→respawn completes without debugger errors.
No canonical Master mutation; Stage16A 143/143 + stress20/20 and touched regressions remain PASS after Godot implementation.
